patterns.prevention:
• **Audit** all current coaches for engagement and energy levels within 3 days; identify any at risk of low performance or disengagement.

• **Assign** a dedicated backup coach to each centre immediately to prevent service gaps when primary coaches leave or underperform.

• **Brief** coaches on expectations around attendance, punctuality, and consistent energy before their first session; implement spot-check observations in first month.

• **Schedule** weekly check-ins between state managers and centres to surface coach concerns early, before cancellation decisions are made.
